statements.statement: matched_writer_add creates and tracks WriterProxy state for newly matched writers, and matched_writer_remove removes it.

A RELIABLE StatefulReader sends an ACKNACK when it matches a writer, with an empty readerSNState and the F-flag clear, so the writer answers with a HEARTBEAT and DATA sent before the match is requested without waiting for the writer's periodic HEARTBEAT; bitmapBase is 0 for an eProsima or RTI writer (the only form Fast DDS answers) and 1 otherwise; it is resent every RTPS_PREEMPTIVE_ACKNACK_RETRY_MS until any HEARTBEAT, DATA, GAP or fragment submessage from the writer arrives, at most RTPS_PREEMPTIVE_ACKNACK_ATTEMPTS times in all for a user reader and RTPS_BUILTIN_PREEMPTIVE_ACKNACK_ATTEMPTS for a builtin one; a BEST_EFFORT reader sends none.
on_data accepts new DATA samples and suppresses duplicates: every change is delivered at most once.
A DATA whose StatusInfo disposes or unregisters the instance is delivered with the corresponding NOT_ALIVE ChangeKind and its key hash, even when it carries no serialized payload.
A sample larger than the largest pool block is resolved as LOST on its first fragment, so it is not requested forever and later changes keep flowing.
HEARTBEAT processing requests ACKNACK when changes are missing, and immediate ACKNACK is sent when heartbeatResponseDelay is zero.
on_heartbeat_frag identifies missing fragments for a sample and sends NACK_FRAG with the missing fragment bitmap.
A reliable reader keeps every MISSING change requested until DATA or GAP resolves it, however many later changes arrive, and delivers every change exactly once.
A DATA carrying neither serialized payload nor key still accounts for its sequence number.
A best-effort reader delivers a change only when it is newer than every change already seen from that writer.

A reliable StatefulReader answering a HEARTBEAT requests each MISSING change of which some fragments have arrived with a NACK_FRAG naming exactly its missing fragments, in the ACKNACK's message, and leaves the change out of the ACKNACK's readerSNState (bitmapBase unchanged); a change with no fragment received stays in readerSNState.
A StatefulReader sends ACKNACKs to a matched writer at its unicastLocatorList; the WriterProxy refers to the owning record's entry and follows it when it changes.
A reader's ACKNACK count to a writer keeps increasing across an unmatch and rematch of that writer, since the writer ignores an ACKNACK whose count is not above the last it processed.

A reader binds each matched writer's WriterProxy from a pool it may share with other readers: matched_writer_add() succeeds exactly when the pool's admission grants a proxy, a refused match sends no ACKNACK, and matched_writer_remove() and the reader's destruction return its proxies.

A reliable StatefulReader refused a fragmented change because its shared assembly pool is full keeps the change MISSING, requests it whole in the ACKNACK, and delivers it once the writer resends it after a slot frees.

A reliable StatefulReader requests the missing fragments of a partial change with a NACK_FRAG once RTPS_FRAGMENT_REPAIR_DELAY_MS pass without a new fragment of it being stored, repeats it with the wait doubling after each request, up to RTPS_FRAGMENT_REPAIR_MAX_DOUBLINGS times, for at most RTPS_FRAGMENT_REPAIR_ROUNDS rounds while none arrives, and restores the rounds but keeps the doubled wait when a new fragment is stored; a duplicate or rejected fragment neither postpones a request nor restores spent rounds; a new change starts at the first wait; a NACK_FRAG sent in answer to a HEARTBEAT_FRAG or with an ACKNACK counts as a round and delays the next request by the doubled wait; a request that could not be built or sent spends no round and is retried one current wait later; a change received whole, or declared irrelevant by a HEARTBEAT or GAP, is not requested and its slot is freed at once, whether or not its rounds are spent; a best-effort reader never requests.
